Manufacturing / The Bahamas

Bahama Mineral Co.

Developing commercial uses for discarded Bahamian conch shell, beginning with poultry calcium.

Bahama Mineral Co. is pre-commercial and is working toward materials processing and product validation. Its website identifies poultry calcium as the first focus, alongside possible uses in design and other commercial applications. This is development work rather than an existing commercial-scale product operation.
